description: (Tag:biokinetic)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:tactician)(Character)You get all three Pillar Men: Whamuu, Esidisi, and Kars. Thousands-year-old super vampires, they absorb people, regenerate, and manipulate their bodies but are vulnerable to sunlight. Esidisi is a master strategist, Whamuu a genius warrior, and Kars a genius intellect.
